title: Desktop JS path never navigates to the review screen after the final answer saves
detail: The bare-URL review navigation sits inside the shouldStep(isMobile) branch, so on desktop the final PUT only shows the Saved indicator. The review screen is a separate GET render ("Landing / question (?q=<id>) / review / state page per the classifier"), so desktop JS users are left on a stale questions page; no-JS desktop reaches review via the 303 POST.
recommended_fix: Move the bare-URL navigation out of the mobile gate so the final save always loads the review screen, or have the server render a review CTA after the last question on desktop.

title: _focus_seconds claims tab-visibility semantics but counts all wall-clock time
detail: Both the JS header and the spec promise "seconds since page init while the tab is visible", but no visibilitychange tracking exists anywhere in the file; Date.now() - initMs counts backgrounded time in full, inflating the fraud signal rc3-4 consumes.
recommended_fix: Accumulate only visible time via a document.visibilitychange handler, or change the documented contract to plain elapsed seconds and rename the field accordingly.

title: AC6 promises the /apply 2s timing floor reused as-is; decision 12 changes answer routes to 500ms
evidence:
+Given the answer/resend POSTs, when they arrive, then the honeypot field (`_website`) and timing validation (`_form_loaded_at`, <2s or >7d suspicious — `application_handler` helpers reused as-is) apply.
+12. **Per-question timing floor is 500ms, not the /apply 2s (AC6 adaptation).** ... Answer POST/PUTs keep every fail-closed branch (missing / unparseable / future / >7d) with a 500ms scripted-replay floor; the single-action resend POST keeps the full 2s `is_timing_suspicious` unchanged. Flagged for Perkins.
detail: The acceptance criterion still asserts the <2s-suspicious posture "reused as-is" while decision 12 sets a 500ms floor for answer POST/PUTs. A tester pinning AC6 asserts behavior the implementation deliberately rejects; the deviation is flagged for Perkins but AC6 was never updated.
recommended_fix: Update AC6 to state the 500ms answer-route floor (resend keeps 2s) so the acceptance criteria match decision 12.

title: Project Structure Notes omit restore_form_token.sql, which the File List ships
evidence:
+- NEW SQL (then `gleam run -m squirrel`): `sql/get_form_context_by_form_token.sql` (row + application pre-fill fields + `vacancy.origin_domain`), `sql/stamp_form_opened.sql` (guarded), `sql/save_draft_answer.sql` (guarded JSONB `||` merge), `sql/remint_form_token.sql` (guarded, per the resend flow).
+- `server/src/reference_checks/sql/restore_form_token.sql` (new — edge-case fix 2)
detail: The canonical new-SQL inventory in the spec body lists four files, but the File List and completion notes ship a fifth (restore_form_token.sql, the all-channels-failed remint rollback). Future readers get an incomplete map of the story's SQL surface.
recommended_fix: Add restore_form_token.sql (guarded remint rollback on all-channels-failed resend) to the Project Structure Notes SQL list.

title: Mobile stepper gate is evaluated once at load; viewport changes never re-evaluate it
detail: isMobile is captured at init and used for every step decision; there is no matchMedia change listener. A tablet loaded in portrait stays in one-question-per-screen mode after rotating to a >=1024px landscape layout, hiding the desktop single-scroll page.
recommended_fix: Re-evaluate the media query on matchMedia 'change' events and re-apply showOnly or reveal all questions accordingly.
